g.text: Learning decisions, then paying for only one path
Candidate outcomes are measured offline; deployment sees only the source and budget.
Measure actual bytes, Y/U/V error and time for all six paths.
Labels use the assembled image; split train/calibration/test by source image.
MLP predicts R̂ₖ, ŜYₖ, ŜUₖ, ŜVₖ for each expert k
time comes from a device / batch-size lookup
calibrate on held-out images; penalize mode-map fragmentation
group patches by selected model before codec execution
ACCOUNTING: router + selected encoder + entropy bytes + model IDs + selected decoder + tile assembly + transfers
Algorithm schematic; bar lengths and colors are illustrative, not measured quality or runtime. Full six-codec search is an offline upper bound and must be charged if run at inference.
